title: Glasshouse and Blue Hour
author: Lior Hartwell
blurb: Ada Ashgrove, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
